text:
Samira (customer): I clicked Redeem in the org portal, got the success email and the green check in the UI, but my credits still show 0. Org id org_98765, code WELCOME-PLG-2026. Can someone look?

Maya (Support): sorry about that — can you confirm the exact time + any confirmation id from the email? I can start checking webhooks and ledger.

Samira (customer): confirmation id claim_5f8c3a — email timestamp 2025-09-14 15:02 UTC. I also got a webhook confirmation page that said "Redeem accepted".

Maya (Support): thanks. I'm pulling the webhook and ledger traces now.

Maya (Support): webhook received from partner. payload snippet:
```json
{
  "claim_id": "claim_5f8c3a",
  "org_id": "org_98765",
  "promo_code": "WELCOME-PLG-2026",
  "amount": 1000,
  "status": "accepted"
}
```

ledger-bot: inbound-webhook/claim_5f8c3a processed (200 OK) - enqueued for ledger-ingest

Devon (Backend): I see the webhook and a grants row created in `promo_grants` for claim_5f8c3a, but the grants row has `billing_account_id = NULL`. Our ledger enqueuer skips grants without a billing_account mapping (guard clause to avoid orphaned credits). That's why no ledger entry posted.

Chris (Billing): why is billing_account_id null? That org was SSO-created — sometimes the tenant->billing mapping job lags. Can you paste the DB row?

Maya (Support): DB row (sanitized):
```sql
id: grant_00083
claim_id: "claim_5f8c3a"
org_id: "org_98765"
amount: 1000
billing_account_id: NULL
created_at: "2025-09-14T15:02:12Z"
status: "accepted"
```

Devon (Backend): yep. mapping service failed to attach a billing_account because the SSO user email domain didn't match expected tenant mapping (edge case). Two safe remediation options: 1) backfill billing_account_id on the grant and re-run ledger enqueuer for that grant, or 2) run the idempotent one-off `grant-reapply-job` which will create the ledger transaction if mapping is now present.

Chris (Billing): I'm going to check billing account for org_98765 now. If it's present, I'll patch the grant.

Chris (Billing): billing_account exists: bill_acct_44. I'll patch the grant to link it.

Chris (Billing): running patch: `UPDATE promo_grants SET billing_account_id='bill_acct_44' WHERE claim_id='claim_5f8c3a';`

Devon (Backend): once patched, run the reapply job: `./bin/grant-reapply --claim=claim_5f8c3a` (idempotent). That will enqueue/create ledger transaction and post to usage balance.

Maya (Support): Samira, do you want us to proceed with the fix now? We'll patch the grant and reapply — there is no cost implication, just applies the credited units.

Samira (customer): Yes please, go ahead.

deploy-bot: queued job grant-reapply-job for claim_5f8c3a on infra-prod (request by Chris).

Devon (Backend): job started. logs show: `grant-reapply: found grant grant_00083, billing_account=bill_acct_44, creating ledger tx tx_8b2f`

ledger-bot: ledger transaction tx_8b2f posted for bill_acct_44 amount=1000 credits (source=promo, claim=claim_5f8c3a)

Maya (Support): I see the ledger entry and usage balance updated. Samira, can you refresh the portal?

Samira (customer): refreshed — balance now shows 1000 credits. Thank you!! :tada:

Maya (Support): great. I'll leave a note on the account explaining root cause (SSO mapping lag caused null billing_account on the grant). We'll add a guard/alert so future grants with null billing_account get flagged to ops instead of silently skipping.

Devon (Backend): filing a quick follow-up ticket in eng-infra to add a monitoring signal on `promo_grants` rows with null billing_account after 5m.

Maya (Support): closing the loop here. Samira, please re-open if anything else comes up.

Samira (customer): all good. thanks everyone! :heart:
